Package game.items

Class Stone

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.items.Item
game.items.SellableItem
game.items.Stone
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Sellable
public class Stone extends SellableItem
Represents a Stone ('*') item that can be sold to the Merchant for 10 coins. Selling a Stone also causes the Merchant to build a Ground on an adjacent tile. The concrete Ground type is injected at construction time, so Stone has no dependency on any specific Ground subclass.
